# SkiCalc

> > Free online ski equipment calculators for sizing skis, poles, and DIN bindings using ISO 11088 standards and evidence-based formulas.

SkiCalc provides specialized calculators for alpine and Nordic skiing equipment selection, helping skiers determine proper ski length, pole size, and binding safety settings based on height, weight, ability level, and skiing style. The tools incorporate industry standards like ISO 11088 for DIN binding calculations and the Canadian wind-chill formula for trip planning.

## Key Topics

- ISO 11088
- DIN binding settings
- BSL (Boot Sole Length)
- Alpine skiing equipment
- Nordic classic skiing
- Nordic skate skiing
- Ski length calculation
- Pole length sizing
- Binding release force
- Ski safety standards
- Equipment sizing guides
- Beginner ski selection
- Canadian wind-chill formula
- Ski gear recommendations

## Core Calculators

- [Ski Size Chart & Calculator | Find Your Perfect Ski Size](https://skicalc.com): Main ski length calculator using height, weight, and style preferences
- [Ski Binding DIN Calculator | Free Online DIN Chart Tool 2025](https://skicalc.com/din): ISO-11088 compliant DIN binding release force calculator for safety
- [Ski Pole Length Calculator | Free Online Pole Size Chart 2025](https://skicalc.com/poles): Pole length calculator for alpine, Nordic classic, and skate skiing

## Optional

- [Wind Chill Calculator | Real-Feel Temperature Tool 2025](https://skicalc.com/windchill): Canadian formula wind-chill calculator for ski trip planning
